statement_en: Assume that $x_n$ is a sequence uniformly distributed modulo $1$. Prove that $x_n + \log(n)$ is also uniformly distributed modulo $1$.
final_code:
import Mathlib

noncomputable section

def UniformDistributedModOne (x : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ 1 →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ =>
        (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
          if (x n - (Int.floor (x n) : ℝ)) ∈ Set.Icc a b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / (N : ℝ))
      Filter.atTop
      (nhds (b - a))

theorem uniformDistributedModOne_add_log
    (x : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hx : UniformDistributedModOne x) :
    UniformDistributedModOne (fun n => x n + Real.log (n : ℝ)) := by
  sorry
